title: Use shlex.split POSIX mode for external pager commands

note.title: Use shlex.split POSIX mode for external pager commands
answers: Why does PAGER fail when the executable path is quoted or contains spaces?
Why should shlex.split use posix=True when parsing command strings on Windows?
How to split PAGER environment variable into argv without retaining quotes?
note.body:
Symptom: Pager or editor commands with quoted paths containing spaces fail to execute on Windows or POSIX.
Root cause: `src/click/_termui_impl.py:pager` called `shlex.split(..., posix=False)`, which preserved surrounding quotes inside argv tokens.
Fix pattern: Use `shlex.split()` in default POSIX mode (`posix=True`) so quotes are stripped from tokens and paths can be cleanly re-quoted by `subprocess`.
Constraints: Applies when converting user-configured command strings into argv lists for `subprocess.Popen`; quotes must be stripped across platforms.
note.applies: Splitting command strings from environment variables like PAGER into subprocess argv.
